text: Shoppers Drug Mart has piloted a free female hygiene product dispenser at 351 Queen Street East to great effect. For those who are economically marginalized, access to these products can come at great expense or sacrifice. The Shoppers Drug Mart project is just one way that our communities are finding ways to help provide those in need with dignity. In order to expand this program and provide wider access to these products, Shoppers Drug Mart would like to expand the pilot to two store locations at 465 Yonge Street and 524 Queen Street West. The dispensers, largely identical to the dimensions and function of newspaper boxes, would need to be located in the public realm in the same space.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Requested Transportation and Right of Way staff exempt 465 Yonge Street, and 524 Queen Street West from Municipal Code Chapter 743 to allow for the temporary installation of free female hygiene product dispensers by Shoppers Drug Mart locations through September 2019.
